description: This source file implements the 'view_compiler' function, which manages file descriptors, constructs command-line arguments, forks a process, executes an external viewcompiler tool, and handles process termination and cleanup. It is part of the Android 'installd' namespace and interacts with system files and processes.

methods.name: view_compiler
methods.description: Handles file opening, process creation, and execution of the external viewcompiler tool, returning success status.
